content: Bwisi yi ɡbere dɑmɡii nɔɔbɑ yiru kuɑ, yi kɑ yin diru bɑnisi.
Mɑ yi derɑ bɑ yɛɛ ɡo, bɑ tɑm sɔɔru kuɑ bɑ ye kpuro yi dii yerɔ.
Mɑ yi yin sɔm kowo tɔn kurɔbu ɡɔrɑ bu yɔ mi n ɡunum bo bu tɔmbu dim sokumɑ,
kpɑ bɑ n mɔ̀, wi u kun bwisi mɔ, u ɡɛrɑmɑ mini,
u nɑ u di yin dii yerɔ, kpɑ u tɑm nɔ mɛ yi sɔɔru kuɑ.
U yɑrio lɑɑkɑri sɑribɑn wuurun di, kpɑ u wɑ u n wɑ̃ɑ wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ. U lɑɑkɑrin swɑɑ mɔɔ.
Bwisiɡii kɑ tii suo
À n tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikio ɡerusi, ɑ tii ɡɛndu kɑsuɑwɑ. À n mɑɑ tɔn kɔ̃so tɑɑrɛ wɛ̃, ɑ tii wɔmburu kɑsuɑwɑ.
À n tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikio ɡerusi, u koo nun tusi. Adɑmɑ ɑ̀ n bwisiɡii ɡerusi, u koo nun kĩɑ.
Ye ɑ bwisiɡii sɔ̃ɔwɑ, yɑ rɑ win bwisi sosiwɑ. Ye ɑ mɑɑ ɡemɡii sɔ̃ɔsi, yɑ rɑ win yɛ̃ru sosiwɑ.
À n kĩ ɑ n bwisi mɔ, ɑ de ɑ ɡinɑ Yinni Gusunɔ nɑsiɑ. À n Gusunɔ Dɛɛro ɡiɑ kɑɑ n yɛ̃ru mɔ.
Bwisi yi koo wunɛn wɑ̃ɑrun tɔ̃ru sosi.
À n kuɑ bwisiɡii, wunɑ kɑɑ yen ɑre di. À n mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ tɔn yɑɑ kɑsikio, wunɑ kɑɑ yen wɑhɑlɑ wɑ.
Gɑri bɑkɑru
Gɑri bɑkɑru tɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe kurɔ wi u ku rɑ tii nɛnɛ sɛ̃ɛ, u ǹ ɡɑ̃ɑnu ɡɑnu yɛ̃.
U rɑ n sɔ̃wɑ win dii kɔnnɔwɔ wuun mi n ɡunum bo.
Min diyɑ u rɑ n tɔmbu sokumɔ be bɑ beɡiru doonɔ,
u n mɔ̀, wi u ǹ lɑɑkɑri mɔ, u ɡɛrɑmɑ mini.
Gɑ̃ɑ nɔrurɑ ye bɑ ɡbɛnɑ, yɑ nɔrubu do. Dim mɛ bɑ dimɔ ɑsiri sɔɔ, mɛnɑ mu rɑ n do.
Adɑmɑ yɛ̃ro kun yɛ̃ mɑ ɡɔribɑ wɑ̃ɑ mi. Be u sokɑ kpuro bɑ rɑ dewɑ ɡɔribun wɑ̃ɑ yerɔ.
Mɔn ni nu kɑ tɔnun dɑɑ yɑ̃
